order.description: The lots' ids in draw order: lab lots first, the earlier expiry, an undated lot after every dated one, the fewer whole units, the lower id.

positions.description: The same order as indexes into the lots given.

takes.description: [id, units] for each lot that gives any, in draw order; null when the lots hold fewer units than wanted (refused).

take_positions.description: The lots of takes as indexes into the lots given.
